DSP only: the diffuser, the layer, the engine that carries it, the plug-in's routing, the tests, the offline renderer and the scores. Editor, processor and state are a colleague's work.

freeze.decidedBy: the owner, 10 October 2026, for Spume and Undertow alike
freeze.rule: Ocean's own: under Freeze the layer in front of the network takes no new input. In every internal sample the layer is given the share the network applies in that sample to what it writes into its lines, one less the hold (FathomNetwork::nextInputShare); the diffuser's input is the layer's input times that share (SpumeLayer::process). The hold moves in a straight line over 50 ms (2205 internal samples), the first step in the first internal sample behind the switch, and lands on its end exactly; a silent network takes the switch at once. The plain input is the network's to take or leave, as before.
freeze.withFreezeOff: the share is one and every sample is what it was, to the bit
freeze.whatWasInTheDiffuserBefore: runs out as it would, by 28.4 dB a second; the held network does not take it, and what is left at the release goes into the network again
freeze.againstTheInputsOwnTime: the network scales what left its input pipeline of 44 samples in that sample, so its share runs a millisecond ahead of the diffuser's, under a glide of fifty

deviationsFromTheSpecification: setLayer takes effect at the next prepare(), as for Undertow: the diffuser's memory is allocated there

two rules of Ocean's own beyond the floor of the lines, where none was expected: the floor of the gains (1e-12), without which a settled Spume at Evolution 0 is not Fathom to the bit, and the block a new Evolution enters at (the first that begins at or after its arrival)
the all-pass holds one delay line, not the model's two, in double precision; the same filter (1.3e-18 from the model's answer to an impulse)
FathomEngine::nextCoreSampleForTesting() is new in the interface: the renderer and the golden test hand a change of Macro over at a block by it
the plug-in blends Fathom and Undertow by their amounts and the two with Spume by theirs; the amount of the three together is the ramp Undertow brought
limits: One host rate was recorded: 48 kHz in blocks of 512. The golden vectors at 44.1 kHz check the port against the model, not the model against the reference; the reference's rule for the block of a new Macro was seen at 48 kHz only.
The reference's Transients and Brightness are not part of Ocean. In Foam its Transients stage sits in front of the diffuser; neither has a law.
The reference's high-pass and low-pass act in front of the diffuser; Ocean's Low Cut and High Damping are filters of its own inside the network's loop, behind it.
A change of mode under signal was never recorded. Ocean crossfades the Characters and enters Spume empty; its oscillators are not restarted there.
Under Evolution automation the plug-in takes a new value at the reference's block or one block (1 ms) later; only the renderer and the golden test place it exactly.
The gains move in stairs of up to 9.5 % of the way once a millisecond, as measured in the reference; not listened to.
The wash has its own length: 28.4 dB a second whatever Decay is, 60 dB down some 3.1 s behind the input at the shortest Decay.
The precision of the reference's all-passes is not known; the engine's lines are double precision.
The 28 delays follow no law the engine uses; the campaign's reading of them is a guess.

Freeze is Ocean's own and was not moved in Foam. What the diffuser took before Freeze runs out in it and, as far as it has not, is heard again when Freeze ends; nothing played under Freeze is in it. Not listened to.
The network's input equaliser is not held: a burst that ends 10 ms in front of the release leaves -138.5 dB of itself at Evolution 0 (nothing at 100 %).
notRun: No listening test, no DAW, no plug-in validator; no plug-in bundle built or rendered here.
No build for x86_64, with GCC or MSVC, or with -ffp-contract=fast.

The Freeze rule in a host.
No recording of the reference at a host rate other than 48 kHz or in blocks other than 512.

No holdout exists for Foam; session T90 is the blind test of the model.
The level of Spume against the other Characters was not measured beyond the wet on noise against Evolution 0.
